prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Stunning royal Indian wedding couple (Duo) standing poised together: a handsome 29-year-old groom with well-groomed beard in a tailored antique ivory and gold sherwani, and a gorgeous 25-year-old Indian bride with radiant smile, delicate kohl eyeliner, and graceful poise in a lavish deep wine and crimson bridal lehenga with royal flair and flowing dupatta. Harmonious styling, romantic dignified presence, natural eye contact, wearing coordinated bespoke wedding couture from Monavi Collection: groom in an antique gold embellished raw silk sherwani with tailored churidar and juttis; bride in a rich deep crimson velvet-silk lehenga with intricate hand-embroidered dabka and zari borders with sheer flowing dupatta. Pristine seams, natural drapery, authentic fabric slub. Setting: Regal Indian heritage palace courtyard, subtle jharokha arches, warm ambient lantern glow. Lighting: Cinematic warm amber lighting, golden hour highlights catching metallic zari embroidery. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Royal family group is positioned elegantly in the right 55-60% of the frame standing together in a sunlit palace courtyard. The left 40-45% has clean architectural backdrop tones reserved for brand typography. Framing rule: Full-length standing portrait showcasing the complete family group in wedding ensembles from head to feet in a continuous sunlit palace haveli courtyard setting. Never crop at waist.
